title: Taste Mahón-Menorca cheese at the dairy
description: Mahón-Menorca cheese carries a Protected Designation of Origin, and it makes far more sense once you have watched it being made. At Subaida you visit the dairy of a working farm and taste the same cheese at several ages: young, semi-cured and cured, one after the other. You leave able to tell an artisan wheel from an industrial one with your eyes shut. Book ahead.
imageAlt: A board with several ages of Mahón-Menorca cheese
